instruction: Visit HuggingFace to find papers from the daily papers list dated March 1, 2024. Extend the document by adding more paper records with complete information (Title, Authors, Abstract, Arxiv PDF).

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(1); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding papers from HuggingFace to docx. Original has 2 'Abstract:' entries. Evaluator counts abstract entries. Expected: at least 3 abstracts. Verified source has 2 abstracts.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification coverage: Instruction requires 'complete information (Title, Authors, Abstract, Arxiv PDF)' but evaluator only checks abstract count
Missing verification for Title field: No check that paper titles are present or properly formatted
Missing verification for Authors field: No check that paper authors are present
Missing verification for Arxiv PDF field: No check that Arxiv PDF links are present
Missing verification for date requirement: No check that papers are from March 1, 2024
Missing verification for source requirement: No check that papers are from HuggingFace daily papers list
Weak verification logic: Getter only counts 'Abstract:' prefix without verifying actual paper structure or content completeness
False positive vulnerability: Task could pass by just adding 'Abstract:' lines without actual complete paper records
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Create a comprehensive getter that extracts structured paper data including all required fields (Title, Authors, Abstract, Arxiv PDF)
Implement metric to verify each paper entry has all 4 required fields present and non-empty
Add validation that abstracts are associated with complete paper records, not standalone text
Consider adding pattern matching to verify paper format matches expected structure
Add count-based partial credit: score based on number of complete papers added (e.g., 1.0 for >=1 complete paper)
